name: MAAP
verdict: Melbourne cycling-apparel company founded by Jarrad Smith and Oliver Cousins. Nothing found.
note: Kit maker for GreenEDGE's teams since 2025, including the Liv AlUla Jayco 2026 kit (Cyclingnews, 2026-01-06). Founded in 2014 by Jarrad Smith and Oliver Cousins; co-founder Oliver Cousins told Cycling Weekly in 2025 that MAAP is a private company with no one else to answer to and no venture capital (cyclingweekly.com, 2025-03-02). No court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against MAAP found (2026-10-03).
